title: WireGuard config
intro: For apps and routers that cannot read a subscription. Each config is one device from your limit and one server.
note: WireGuard is blocked in Russia more often than the other protocols, especially on mobile networks. If a config does not connect, use INCY — it carries Hysteria2 and VLESS.
created: Your config is ready — download the file or scan the QR code in the WireGuard app
full: Every place is taken. Remove a device you no longer use or add a place on the Devices tab.
removed: Config removed — it stops working within a few minutes
removeDescription: The device using this config will stop connecting, and its place in your limit is freed.
qrHint: Open AmneziaVPN or WireGuard on your phone and add the config by scanning the QR code.
qrNote: The QR code is an access key. Do not show it or send the file to anyone else.
noServers: No server runs WireGuard yet — check back later.
unavailable: Could not load your WireGuard configs. Check your connection.

wiresock.name: WireSock Secure Connect
wiresock.hint: The best pick for a PC: it imports a .conf and can route only the programs you choose through the VPN.

amnezia.name: AmneziaVPN
amnezia.hint: The best pick for a phone: add the config through Import — as a file or a QR code.

wireguard.name: WireGuard
wireguard.hint: The official app — for anywhere the first two do not run.
